assign.title: Task (owner, 2026-10-25): voice sessions in the "Switch session" dropdown (ux/Dictate/chat.js session_switcher, fed by S

findings.text: Ask 3 (and the owner's addendum, "label it from its content … make it the default for untitled sessions") is not built: `recent_project()` (Servex/agents/Sessions.js:875) still returns `title: null` for an untitled session and ux/Dictate/chat.js:395 still prints "Session v-xxxxxxx"; no first-words or summary fallback anywhere in the diff.

Renaming the folder breaks every reader that finds a voice session by its folder name: the sessions index takes "id = folder name" (public/framework/ai/sessions/readme.md:45, `AISessionIndex.record_snap`), `/framework/ai/sessions/v-<id>/` redirects through `AISessionDetail.dated_folder` by name (readme.md:59), and `relocate()`/`session_path()` (Sessions.js:513, :694) rebuild `.../DD/<id>/`. A renamed session gets a new id in the index and its `v-` link stops resolving.

The rename moves the whole folder, and a voice session's folder holds its task folders and links (the brief's own task record is `/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/25/v-9dvbbrn/`). Every task_dir, asks.jsonl row and card link into it breaks, and it happens automatically on every topic shift. CLAUDE.md asks for scripted moves with a manifest of old→new paths; this one leaves no manifest and no reference behind. A simpler way that meets ask 2 without moving anything: show the folder's own name (`v-xxxxxxx`) or write the slug as the session's display name, and leave the folder alone. Or name the folder from the title once, when it is first made, and never move it after.

The Follow patch never matches. `tail_log()` subscribes with `rel` = `public/framework/ai/sessions/…/session.jsonl` (Sessions.js:293), but `rename()` compares against `s.file` with the leading slash stripped, which is `framework/ai/…` with no `public/` (diff, `old_path`). So the smart seat's tail stays on the old, missing file. Patching `sub.path` would also skip `follow.save()` and Follow's watcher/offset maps (Servex/Follow.js:107).

`rename()` runs `git mv` on the main working tree from inside Servex (Sessions.js, `execFileSync("git", … "mv")`). That stages renames in the owner's index while the owner and the log sweeper are committing, which is a runtime side effect no other session writer has.

Readmes are stale or missing the new behaviour. public/framework/ai/sessions/readme.md:33/46 still say a ✦ session's folder is `v-<id>`. ext/Session/doc/sessions.md isn't touched. Servex/agents' readme doesn't list the new `rename_session` tool or the `renamed` live event, and no client handles that event (grep finds no `renamed` reader in ux/Dictate or ext/Chat).

A fresh agent can't continue from this task folder alone. It has no requirements.md (the brief lives only in the agent's prompt), session.jsonl has no outcome or landing line, and there is no screenshot, although the brief asked to "verify with a screenshot". The commit 9b4fe7c98 sits on `worktree/session-names`, unmerged, and nothing in the folder says so.

Ask 1 looks met: tools.js now takes the session id from `ctx.caller` (`session-smart-<id>`, matching `name: s.id` at Sessions.js:1340) for `session_summary`, `session_line` and `rename_session`. But nothing confirms that "no session undefined" really came from this; no log line or test reproduces it.

The refetch-on-click in chat.js (`$switch.el.addEventListener("click", paint)`) is a no-op on the click that opens the menu, because of the `open_menu?.showing()` guard. It only refreshes on the next click, so the list you see on open can still be stale. Refetching before the menu opens, or on the Popover's open hook, would show a fresh list on the first open.

session-smart.md step 3 drops "in your FIRST turn, every time" for "once the topic is clear". That suits a slug that moves the folder, but if finding 3 is fixed by never moving it, the earlier, stricter rule may be worth keeping.

Ask 3 and the owner's addendum ("label it from its content … make it the default for untitled sessions") are still not built after the review round: ux/Dictate/chat.js:395 still prints `"Session " + row.session`, and `recent_project()` / `summary_of()` (Servex/agents/Sessions.js:877, :882) still return `title: null` with no fallback from the first words of the owner's first line or the summary. This was finding 1 last round, and commit 02d27a969 does not touch it.

Ask 2 ("the name shown in the dropdown matches the session's own folder name … so the same name appears in both places") is now not met. The folder move was dropped for a sound reason (the smart seat's item-tool `path` is handed out once, at spawn; see the comment above `rename_session`, Sessions.js:912), but titled sessions now show a title in the dropdown and `v-<id>` in the folder, so the two still differ. The owner hasn't been told: the reason lives only in code comments and in core/Item/readme.md:78. Either build one of last round's two simple options (show the folder name `v-xxxxxxx` beside the title, or name the folder from the title once, when it is made), or put the deviation and its reason in the task's report so the owner can decide.

The docs describe a client that doesn't exist. ext/Session/doc/sessions.md:63/:77 and the `session_summary` tool text (Servex/agents/tools.js:209) say "a live client redraws the new title from one `renamed` event", but nothing in ux/Dictate, ext/Chat or ext/Session reads `kind: "renamed"` (grep finds no reader). Either add the reader to `session_switcher`/Chat, or say the event is pushed and nothing listens to it yet.

A fresh agent still can't continue from this task folder alone. There is still no requirements.md (the brief exists only in the agent's first prompt), session.jsonl has no outcome or landing line, and there is no screenshot, although the brief asks you to "verify with a screenshot". Both commits (9b4fe7c98, 02d27a969) sit on `worktree/session-names` at C:/Code/lew42/worktrees/session-names, unmerged, and nothing in the folder says so.

The refetch-on-click (chat.js:408) still never refreshes the list you are looking at. On the opening click, `paint()` awaits the fetch, finds `open_menu.showing()` true and throws the rows away; it only repaints on the closing click. The comment admits this. Refetching on `pointerdown`/`focus` before the open, or rebuilding the menu once the fetch lands, would show a fresh list on the first open. ux/Dictate/doc/chat.md:108-115 doesn't mention the refetch.

session-smart.md step 3 now waits "once the topic is clear" to name the session, which keeps a session on `Session v-xxxxxxx` for longer. Because ask 3's fallback isn't built, that makes the unnamed rows the owner complained about more common, not less. Once the folder stopped moving, the reason for relaxing the rule went away too (last round's note 10).

Ask 1 looks met: `caller_session(ctx.caller)` (tools.js:205) overrides the session id the model types, for `session_summary`, `rename_session` and `session_line`. Sessions.test.mjs passes 27 checks in the worktree. Still, nothing reproduces "no session undefined", so it isn't proven to be the cause.

`rename_session` (Sessions.js:926) is a second tool for a flow that doesn't exist yet ("a future rename-proposal flow"), and `session_summary` already covers renaming. Less is more: it could wait until that flow is built.
